messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for wave=staging-edge, version=v3.2.1, cohort=30% :rocket:
incident-bot: Alert: canary-health-failure triggered on svc=edge-proxy — 503 rate > 5% over 30s. Paging SRE oncall. :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Pager: Incident triggered — paging ben (oncall).
ben: Ack — I'm on it. What do we know so far?
alice: Seeing spike of 503s originating from tokenization service behind edge-proxy. Logs show repeated "kvcache: upstream timeout". Spike started ~12:03 UTC, matches rollout window.
carla: This wave included the new kv-prefetch routing (edge-routing-v2). If kvcache thrash is the cause, we should kill the flag and stop traffic to the cohort.
ben: @carla please flip the flag. I'll abort rollout and cut traffic back to prior variant.
carla: Disabling flag now.
carla: `POST https://flags.internal/api/edge-routing-v2/disable 200 OK` — cohort->0% applied.
deploy-bot: Action: traffic for wave=staging-edge reduced to 0% (flag disable by carla).
alice: Healthchecks improving: 503 rate down from ~6.2% -> 1.2% over the last 60s, but p95 latency still elevated for small requests.
dmitri: Any external customer impact? Do we need comms?
ben: Early telemetry suggests internal-only degradation; a handful of partner integrations in us-west saw failed embedding calls ~1.5% failure rate.
carla: We're also seeing kvcache churn on quantized executor when prefix>512 — suspect the new routing increases cache pressure. Recommend pinning to previous routing and adding cache guard.
alice: Running quick inspection: `kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=edge-proxy --since=2m | grep kvcache | tail -n 50` — seeing timeouts to model-worker-7 and repeated reconnects.
ben: Good. If metrics keep trending down, stand down pager. For mitigation: disable flag (done) + restart edge-proxy pods to clear stale connections. Who can run the restart?
alice: I can. Plan: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n runtime` then monitor healthchecks for 3 consecutive probes.
ben: Proceed.
deploy-bot: Rollout restart started for deployment/edge-proxy (5 pods).
alice: Pods restarted, healthchecks back to healthy for 3 probes. 503s now ~0.4% and falling. Monitoring for 10m.
ben: If 5xx resurfaces we'll do full rollback of the staging wave. For now, immediate pager clear if no new alerts.
pagerduty: Pager cleared — incident acknowledged closed.
carla: Created INC-5177 in tracker with timeline and actions taken. Will pin model binary on staging to previous build and add kvcache instrumentation.
dmitri: Thanks. Hold off on customer comms until postmortem confirms scope.
ben: Handoff: @carla you'll own the postmortem, assign ops actions to @alice. I'm available for follow-up. Night oncall gets this in 30m; leaving notes here.
alice: Adding logs and dashboards to INC-5177. ETA for initial writeup: 24h.
carla: Adding a short runbook entry under /runbooks/deploy-canary-killflags.md describing flag killflow and quick restart checklist.
incident-bot: Summary: Flag disabled, cohort traffic -> 0%, edge-proxy pods restarted, healthchecks recovered. Follow-up: eng-runtime instrumentation + postmortem. :white_check_mark:
